newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria FinMin rejects some bids for 4-wk T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria FinMin rejects some bids for 4-wk T-bills.

text.p: The Bulgarian Finance Ministry has pared the amount of accepted bids for Monday's auction of four-week discount T-bills to meet central bank regulations, a finance ministry official said.
"The ministry approved bids for 23.871 billion lev worth of T-bills," a finance ministry official told Reuters.
A central bank official told Reuters earlier on Monday that the ministry has approved bids for the total amount on offer or 24 billion levs.

The correction was in line with a central bank regulation, which bans a single financial institution from acquiring more than 50 percent of the total par on offer at government securities auctions, the finance ministry official said.

The average yield to maturity on the issue was 3.77 percent as reported earlier by the central bank official, down from 3.81 percent on Thursday and Friday and 3.80 percent at Wednesday's auction, central bank figures showed.
